facts.fact: 冰淇淋日的加拿大枫糖浆之辩：他自称 simple man 且是认真的。
facts.anchor: I’m a simple man, with simple tastes.” He purses his lips and to my surprise—he’s completely serious.

facts.fact: 她提议回高中——一切开始的地方，把最后一天拖到最长。
facts.anchor: If we’re going to have one last day before he leaves, I want it to last as long as possible, so why not go to where it all started?

facts.fact: 停车场里他说本以为离开会很兴奋，话到一半停住。
她的心事：重新开始听起来很美，只是她不想成为「他丢下的东西」。
facts.anchor: I just wish I didn’t have to be the thing he left.

facts.fact: 他的判词：我们只是在错的时间遇见了彼此。
facts.anchor: We just found each other at the wrong time.

facts.fact: 他请求：就今天，假装我们有全世界的时间。
facts.anchor: Can we pretend like we have all the time in the world together?

facts.fact: 他的投降书：也许将来你会跟别人在一起，他不在乎——只想此刻爱她，也要她一起放下。
facts.anchor: I just want to love you, right here, right now

facts.fact: 卡车边的初吻：温柔而急切，像等了一辈子。
facts.anchor: Like he’s been waiting his whole life to have his lips on mine.

facts.fact: 吻后他轻声说：让我留下来吧——她答不出这句话。
facts.anchor: “Ask me to stay,” he breathes out.

facts.fact: Reconsider 被拒后他交出最后的牌：可是我爱你，Bee。
Peyton 喊 Kiss Kiss Kiss 搅局后，Sean 用满脸碎吻把这一天夺回来。
facts.anchor: pecking kisses all over my face, seemingly determined to not let Peyton take this day away from us.
